# Office of Dietary Supplements (ODS)

> The NIH Office of Dietary Supplements provides evidence-based information, research resources, and consumer protection guidance on dietary supplements, vitamins, minerals, and botanical products.

ODS is a division of the National Institutes of Health dedicated to strengthening knowledge and understanding of dietary supplements through scientific research, education, and public health initiatives. The office serves consumers, healthcare professionals, researchers, and regulatory agencies with authoritative supplement information and quality assurance programs.

## Key Topics

- Dietary supplements
- Vitamins and minerals
- Botanical research
- Supplement safety
- Natural products
- Nutrient recommendations
- FDA regulation
- Consumer protection
- Health information

- NIH research
- NCCIH collaboration

## Core Resources & Overview

- [Office of Dietary Supplements (ODS)](https://ods.od.nih.gov): NIH Office of Dietary Supplements homepage with overview of programs and resources
- [Health Information](https://ods.od.nih.gov/HealthInformation/healthinformation.aspx): ODS health information hub with fact sheets and safety guidance on supplements
- [Information for Health Professionals](https://ods.od.nih.gov/HealthInformation/healthprofessional.aspx): Evidence-based supplement resources for healthcare professionals and practitioners
- [Programs & Activities](https://ods.od.nih.gov/Research/programsandactivities.aspx): ODS research programs, grants, and databases including CARDS and DSID

## Dietary Supplement Reference Database

- [Dietary Supplement Fact Sheets](https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/list-all): Comprehensive directory of ODS dietary supplement fact sheets and reference database
- [Dietary Supplements: What You Need to Know - Consumer](https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/WYNTK-Consumer): Consumer guide on supplement labels, safety, effectiveness, and regulations
- [Dictionary of Dietary Supplement Terms](https://ods.od.nih.gov/HealthInformation/dictionary.aspx): Searchable dictionary of dietary supplement terminology and health terms
- [Nutrient Recommendations and Databases](https://ods.od.nih.gov/HealthInformation/nutrientrecommendations.aspx): DRI standards, RDA guidelines, and nutrient intake assessment databases

## Consumer Information & Safety

- [Consumer Awareness & Protection](https://ods.od.nih.gov/HealthInformation/consumerprotection.aspx): Federal resources on supplement safety alerts and health fraud prevention
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://ods.od.nih.gov/HealthInformation/ODS_Frequently_Asked_Questions.aspx): FAQ covering supplement safety, regulation, and nutritional guidance
- [Información para el consumidor](https://ods.od.nih.gov/HealthInformation/RecursosEnEspanol.aspx): Spanish-language consumer information on dietary supplements and health resources

## Research & Quality Programs

- [NIH Consortium for Advancing Research on Botanical and Other Natural Products (CARBON) Program](https://ods.od.nih.gov/Research/Dietary_Supplement_Research_Centers.aspx): CARBON research consortium for botanical and natural products studies
- [AMRM Program Website](https://ods.od.nih.gov/Research/AMRMProgramWebsite.aspx): Analytical Methods and Reference Materials Program for supplement quality assurance

## News, Events & Education

- [ODS Videos](https://ods.od.nih.gov/About/ODS_Videos.aspx): Educational video content and ODS Seminar Series recordings on supplements
- [News & Events](https://ods.od.nih.gov/News/newsandevents.aspx): ODS news, events, seminars, and newsletter announcements
- [ODS Digest: News & Insights](https://ods.od.nih.gov/News/ODS_Update.aspx): ODS newsletter with research funding updates and health insights
- [Announcements and News Releases](https://ods.od.nih.gov/News/News_Releases.aspx): Official ODS announcements on strategic plans and leadership appointments
- [ODS Seminars, Conferences, and Workshops](https://ods.od.nih.gov/News/Conferences_and_Workshops.aspx): Archive of ODS seminars and conferences on botanical and natural products

## Optional

- [Headline History](https://ods.od.nih.gov/News/archive.aspx): Chronological archive of ODS news, fact sheets, and announcements
- [Media Requests](https://ods.od.nih.gov/News/Media_Contacts.aspx): Media contact information for ODS and federal agency inquiries
